D: Sam Wilson takes on the shield and is pulled into a conspiracy around the new President.
P: Serve dessert when Sam reminds Red Hulk Ross of the cherry blossoms.
S: Toasted baguette with whipped ricotta and honey thyme cherries
Baguette slices toasted, spread with whipped ricotta and topped with cherries cooked with honey and thyme.
Joaquin's wings, baked crisp with paprika and honey barbecue glaze
Chicken wings baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a smoky barbecue and honey glaze.
crab, mayo, mustard and panko patties, pan-fried golden, lemony dip, for the new Captain America

Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, shaped and pan-fried until golden, with a lemon remoulade. Mix 400g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 beaten egg, 2 sliced spring onions, a pinch of cayenne and 50g panko crumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Coat in more panko and pan-fry in oil and butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. For remoulade, mix 120g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, 1 tsp paprika, lemon juice and parsley. Serve with lemon wedges.
M: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage, capsicum and celery
Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum and celery, over rice.
Red Hulk eye fillet with red wine jus
Since when were they red? Medium-rare, sir.

Beef eye fillet roasted to medium-rare with a red wine sauce, potato gratin and asparagus. Season a 1kg beef eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes. Slice 1kg potatoes thinly, layer in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, garlic and salt, and bake at 180C for 60 minutes before the beef goes in. Deglaze the beef pan with 200ml red wine, add 200ml beef stock and reduce by half, then whisk in 20g butter. Serve with steamed asparagus.
W: Ross and Betty's cherry blossoms: meringue, cream, cherries, rose petals
Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes, topped with whipped cream, cherries and pale pink rose petals.
K: Strawberry puree and lemon juice over ice, topped with bubbles

Fresh strawberries blitzed with lemon and sugar, strained and topped with soda water over ice, with a halved strawberry on the rim. Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 3 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth, then push through a sieve. Fill 4 glasses with ice and divide the strawberry purée between them. Top each with 200ml soda water and stir gently. Finish with a halved strawberry on the rim and a strip of lemon peel.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the cherries up to 3 days ahead and keep them chilled; toast the bread and whip the ricotta on the day

steps.text: Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Simmer the cherries with honey and thyme until jammy, then cool.
Whip the ricotta until smooth.
Spread the toasts with ricotta and spoon the cherries on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Toss the wings in the paprika and salt up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Toss the wings with paprika and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce, honey and butter until glossy.
Toss the wings through the glaze and serve with napkins.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the florets up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; batter, bake and glaze on the night

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Whisk the flour, water, paprika and salt into a batter and coat the florets.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the rest of the oil and bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce, honey and butter until glossy.
Toss the florets through the glaze and bake again until sticky. Serve with napkins.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the gumbo up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; reheat gently and cook the rice fresh

steps.text: Dice the onion, capsicum and celery and slice the sausage and chicken.
Cook the flour in the oil, stirring, until dark brown.
Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften them.
Add the chicken, sausage, okra and water and simmer.
Cook the rice and serve the gumbo over it.

veg.make_ahead: The gumbo keeps up to 2 days in the fridge; reheat gently and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Dice the onion, capsicum and celery and slice the sausages, mushrooms and okra.
Brown the sausages and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil, then lift out.
Cook the flour in the remaining oil, stirring, until dark brown.
Add the onion, capsicum and celery and soften them.
Add the okra, beans, paprika and stock and simmer, cooking the rice while it bubbles.
Return the sausages and mushrooms, simmer 5 minutes and serve over the rice.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the meringue and cool it in the oven up to 1 day ahead, stored airtight; cook the cherries, whip the cream and top just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the meringue sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.
Shape into a round on a lined tray.
Bake at 120C, then cool in the oven.
Cook the cherries briefly with the cherry sugar and whip the cream.
Top the pavlova with cream, cherries and rose petals.

dishes.make_ahead: Blitz and sieve the strawberry puree up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; add the ice and soda water just before serving

steps.text: Hull the strawberries, keeping four for garnish. Juice one lemon and peel strips from the other.
Blitz the rest of the strawberries with sugar and lemon juice, then sieve.
Fill four glasses with ice and share the puree between them.
Top with soda water, stir gently, and finish with a halved strawberry and lemon peel.

s.note: Toasted baguette with whipped ricotta and honey thyme cherries
s.how: Slice a baguette and toast until golden. Simmer 300g frozen cherries with 2 tbsp honey and thyme for 8 minutes until jammy, then cool. Whip 250g ricotta until smooth, spread on the toasts and spoon the cherries on top.

s.note: Joaquin's wings, baked crisp with paprika and honey barbecue glaze
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with smoked paprika and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 125ml barbecue sauce with 2 tbsp honey and 30g butter until glossy. Toss the wings through the glaze and serve with plenty of napkins.

m.note: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage, capsicum and celery
m.how: Cook 60g flour in 60ml oil for 20 minutes, stirring, until dark brown. Add diced onion, green capsicum and celery and soften. Add 600g chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, okra and 1.5L water. Simmer for an hour and serve over long grain rice.

w.note: Ross and Betty's cherry blossoms: meringue, cream, cherries, rose petals
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, cherries cooked briefly with sugar and pale pink rose petals.

d.note: Strawberry puree and lemon juice over ice, topped with bubbles
d.how: Blitz 250g hulled strawberries with 3 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth, then push through a sieve. Fill 4 glasses with ice and divide the strawberry purée between them. Top each with 200ml soda water and stir gently. Finish with a halved strawberry on the rim and a strip of lemon peel.
